sources.title: EV Database - Volvo XC40 Recharge Twin Pure Electric (MY22)
sources.notes: European spec page: 78 kWh nominal / 75 usable, NMC, 400 V, 149 kW measured max, AC 11 kW, preconditioning supported and can start automatically via navigation.

sources.title: EV Database - Volvo XC40 Recharge Twin Motor (MY24)
sources.notes: European 2024 spec page: 82 kWh nominal / 79 usable, NMC 108s1p prismatic, 400 V, Volvo-claimed 205 kW, AC 11 kW, preconditioning (automatic via navigation). The European 2024 Twin got the 82 kWh pack; the US/Canada 2024 Twin kept 78 kWh.

sources.title: EV Database - Volvo EX40 Twin Motor (MY26-27)
sources.notes: European 2026 spec page: 82 kWh nominal / 79 usable, NMC, 400 V, 207 kW tested (Volvo claims 205 kW), AC 11 kW, 28 min claimed 10-80%, preconditioning automatic via navigation.

sources.title: InsideEVs - Volvo Outlines 2024 C40 Recharge And XC40 Recharge Upgrades
sources.notes: Relays Volvo US 2024 announcement: RWD single motor 82 kWh, 200 kW, 10-80% about 28 min; AWD keeps 78 kWh and 150 kW (37 min for the 78 kWh pack at 150 kW).

sources.title: Conceptcarz - Volvo Car USA announces 2024 line-up with new fully electric powertrains (copy of Volvo US press release)
sources.notes: Copy of the Volvo Car USA 2024 release: Single Motor 82 kWh, 200 kW DC, 10-80% about 28 min; Twin Motor retains 78 kWh at 150 kW DC. Volvo media pages themselves return 403 to the fetcher.

sources.title: InsideEVs - 2025 Volvo EX40 rename (XC40 Recharge becomes EX40)
sources.notes: Volvo US 2025 pricing release relayed: Twin Motor gets 82 kWh (from 78), DC peak 200 to 205 kW for both Single and Twin Motor. The article text says single-motor versions keep 78 kWh, which contradicts the 2024 US release (single already 82 kWh) and Green Car Reports.

sources.title: Green Car Reports - 2025 Volvo EX40 (formerly XC40 Recharge) price and specs
sources.notes: 2025 EX40: 82 kWh single-motor, 78 kWh dual-motor per this article (conflicts with the Volvo US release as relayed by InsideEVs); DC up from 200 to 205 kW.

sources.title: Kelley Blue Book - 2026 Volvo EX40 specs
sources.notes: Lists 82 kWh battery for 2026 EX40 Plus and Ultra Black Edition (Twin Motor AWD, 402 hp, 260 mi). No charging data.

sources.title: Volvo Car Canada release (Cision) - Volvo Cars to open access to more than 17,800 NACS charging points through Tesla Supercharger network
sources.notes: Volvo Canada release: owners of fully electric Volvo cars can order a NACS adapter (CA$310) from Nov 18, 2024; included with new 2025 EX90/EX40/EC40; EX30 adapter to be announced later.

sources.title: InsideEVs - Volvo, Polestar Owners Get Tesla Supercharger Access
sources.notes: US: NACS adapter $230 for existing Volvo and Polestar 2 owners via dealers/Service Points; free with 2025 EX90/EX40/EC40. EX30 adapter to be announced later (Oct 2024).

sources.title: Wikipedia - Volvo EX40
sources.notes: Powertrain table: 150 kW peak for 69 and 78 kWh packs, 175 kW (earlier figure) for 2023+ RWD/twin; 82 kWh from 2022-23; NMC; 11 kW AC. Page is internally inconsistent on pack sizes.

sources.title: Volvo Cars Canada support - EX40 Charging time
sources.notes: Page returned 403 to the fetcher; content read only from a search-result excerpt: highest AC charging output 11 kW (single-phase 48 A = 11 kW, about 8 h); preconditioning of the battery when a rapid charger is set as the destination in Google Maps.

sources.title: InsideEVs - 2025 Volvo EX30 Range, Specs And Pricing Overview
sources.notes: US EX30 (Single Motor Extended Range RWD and Twin Motor Performance AWD): 69 kWh gross / 64 usable NMC, 153 kW DC peak, AC about 11 kW, 10-80% about 26.5 min, CCS1 initially. Europe LFP 51/49 kWh at 134 kW is a separate pack.

sources.title: InsideEVs - 2025 Volvo EX30 Charging Test Is A Little Disappointing
sources.notes: US-spec 2025 Twin Motor Performance tested at an Electrify America charger: about 150 kW at 8% SoC; Tesla Supercharger attempt failed (no adapter used).

sources.title: EV Database - Volvo EX30 Twin Motor Performance (MY24-26)
sources.notes: 69 kWh nominal / 65 usable NMC, 392 V nominal (400 V architecture), Volvo-claimed 153 kW, AC 11 kW standard (22 kW optional in Europe), preconditioning auto via navigation, 28 min 10-80%.

sources.title: Kelley Blue Book - 2026 Volvo EX30 specs
sources.notes: All four 2026 US EX30 trims (Single Motor Extended Range Plus RWD, Twin Motor Performance Plus/Ultra/Cross Country Ultra AWD) list a 69.00 kWh battery.

sources.title: The Charge Port - NACS Port & Adapter Checker 2026
sources.notes: US checker verified 2026-10-20: Volvo EX30 (2025-2026) is CCS1 with a paid adapter (read from search excerpt; the fetched summary did not list rows); Polestar charges for the adapter.

sources.title: Polestar US - Polestar 2 2024 manual: Electric vehicle functions with Google Maps
sources.notes: Says: when charging stations have been added in Google Maps the battery will be preconditioned to reduce charging time. No manual control mentioned.

sources.title: Polestar US - Polestar 2 2023 manual: Charging time
sources.notes: Vehicle max AC output 11 kW (single-phase 48 A = 11 kW); DC 10-80% about 35 min at a 150 kW station; battery preconditioning is triggered by adding a rapid charging station as a destination in Google Maps.

sources.title: Polestar US - Polestar 2 2021 manual: Charging output
sources.notes: AC max 11 kW; DC rapid charging up to 150 kW, 0-80% about 35 min at 150 kW; preconditioning lengthens charging time.

sources.title: Polestar US - Polestar 2 specifications (Long range Dual motor with Performance pack)
sources.notes: 400 V lithium-ion, 82 kWh capacity (gross/usable not split), up to 205 kW DC, 10-80% in 28 min, AC 11 kW.

sources.title: InsideEVs - 2024 Polestar 2 EPA Ratings Reveal Increased Range And Efficiency
sources.notes: US 2024 Polestar 2: Single Motor RWD 82 kWh, up to 205 kW, 28 min 10-80% (2023: 78 kWh, 155 kW, 35 min); Dual Motor and Performance Pack 78 kWh, up to 155 kW, 34 min.

sources.title: Wikipedia - Polestar 2
sources.notes: Spec table (garbled column order): Long Range 78/75 kWh gross/usable 2021-2023 (single) and dual motor 2021-2024; 82/79 for single 2024-25 and dual 2025; NMC all packs; DC 155 kW (2021-23), 205 kW (2024+ single, 2025 dual); AC 11 kW.

sources.title: EV Database - Polestar 2 Long Range Dual Motor (MY24)
sources.notes: European 2024 page: 82 kWh nominal / 79 usable, NMC, 400 V, Polestar-claimed 205 kW, AC 11 kW, preconditioning automatic via navigation. (European 2024 dual had 82 kWh; US 2024 dual kept 78 kWh.)
